extraction_notes: Only this-work ammonia-synthesis records were extracted. Literature-comparison rows in Extended Data Table 1 (refs. 16,21–27) were excluded. The Cs–Ru(10 wt%)/MgO reference measurement in Methods was excluded because the paper states it reached equilibrium conversion at 400 °C. Pure-H2 lattice-nitrogen experiments and N2 isotope-exchange experiments were excluded because they are not steady NH3 synthesis from N2/H2. Very small Fig. 2a bars for Ni/C12A7:e−, Ni nanoparticles, Ni/La2O3, Ni/MgO, Ni/AC, and LaN bulk were not extracted because exact values are not printed and the bars are too close to zero on the plotted scale to read reliably. Dense stability/time-course panels (Fig. 2b and Extended Data Fig. 6e) were not digitized beyond the tabulated steady rates.
